race.comment: Plenty of realistic chances. Going the way of OMAHA DAWN (9) who had been racing in great heart until bumping into Sir Now and others in the Listed Wylie last start. Four of his five wins have come with Stubby Holder aboard and he reunites. Great chance to bounce back to form in this more suitable affair. Veteran mare STARLITE VALLEY (10) disappointed last time out in open company over 1200m at Morphettville after bolting in the start prior over today's journey. Coming back to 1000m is the tick, although no placings from five appearances here is a worry. DAISYDOO (14) is in a rich vein of form, savaging the line at her last couple for a win and a placing over slightly longer journeys. Will be flashing home. BOYD (15) returned in great order last time and is ready to tackle this better race.
